scopes.PRIVSET.Recommission Fabric Extender (FE: Reactivate and restore a previously decommissioned Fabric Extenders (FEX), reestablishing connections and updating the system status.
scopes.PRIVSET.Recommission chassis: Reactivate and restore previously decommissioned chassis.
scopes.PRIVSET.Recommission servers: Bring a previously decommissioned server back into operational status. Allows read access to Fabric Interconnect.
scopes.PRIVSET.Rediscover Fabric Extender (FEX): As a Rediscover Fabric Extender user, you can initiate a rediscovery process for fabric extenders,
scopes.PRIVSET.Rediscover chassis: Initiate a process to re-scan and identify chassis in the network, updating their status and configurations.
scopes.PRIVSET.Rediscover servers: Initiate a process to re-scan and identify servers in the network, updating their status and configurations.
scopes.PRIVSET.Regenerate domain names: Refresh or recreate a domain name within the system, updating its configuration or resolving issues related to network addressing and resource identification.
scopes.PRIVSET.Register licenses:
Register Intersight licenses with Cisco Smart Licensing.
Note: This is a virtual appliance only privilege.
scopes.PRIVSET.Remove Fabric Extender (FEX): Safely disconnect and remove Fabric Extenders (FEX) from the system, ensuring proper management of dependencies.
scopes.PRIVSET.Remove chassis: Safely disconnect and remove chassis, ensuring all dependencies are managed.
scopes.PRIVSET.Remove servers: Disconnect the server from the network, erase all data, and update inventory records to reflect the change.
scopes.PRIVSET.Renew licenses:
Update the Intersight license to include any changes on Cisco Smart Software Manager.
Note: This is a virtual appliance only privilege.
scopes.PRIVSET.Replace Fabric Interconnect: Oversee the replacement process for Fabric Interconnects (FIs).
scopes.PRIVSET.Reserve licenses:
Reserve licensing slots for specific private virtual appliance (PVA).
Note: This is a virtual appliance only privilege.
scopes.PRIVSET.Reset CMOS: AReset CMOS settings, restoring BIOS to default.
scopes.PRIVSET.Reset IOMs and IFMs: Reboot Input/Output Module (IOM) or Intelligent Fabric Module (IFM).
scopes.PRIVSET.Reset peer IOMs and IFMs: Reboot peer IOM or IFM to resolve issues.
scopes.PRIVSET.Reset vKVM: Reset vKVM session, restarting the interface.
scopes.PRIVSET.Return licenses:
Deregister the Intersight private virtual appliance (PVA) license after the initial setup.
Note: This is a virtual appliance only privilege.
scopes.PRIVSET.Run Workflows: As a Run Workflows user, you can execute workflows in the system.
scopes.PRIVSET.Run interoperability checks: Run an interoperability check on integrated systems.
scopes.PRIVSET.SAN Administrator:
As a SAN Administrator, you can create, update, delete and view the Managed SAN switch objects.
The capability to view and execute workflows against the SAN switches is also granted.

This role does not include the ability to claim a target.  You must have a Device Technician,
Device Administrator, or an Account Administrator role to claim a target.
scopes.PRIVSET.SAN Connectivity policies: Manage storage area network (SAN) settings for servers.
scopes.PRIVSET.SAN Operator:
As a SAN Operator, you can view the Managed SAN switch objects. The capability to view workflows against the
SAN switches is also granted. This role does not include the ability to claim a target.

You must have a Device Technician, Device Administrator, or an Account Administrator role to
claim a target.
scopes.PRIVSET.SD Card policies: Configure the Cisco FlexFlash and FlexUtil Secure Digital (SD) cards for Cisco UCS servers. This policy specifies details of virtual drives on the SD cards and allows configuration in different modes such as Operating System Only, Utility Only, or Operating System + Utility modes.
scopes.PRIVSET.SD card operations: Manage SD card operations like mounting and formatting.
scopes.PRIVSET.SMTP policies: Set SMTP client preferences for outgoing communications on managed devices.
scopes.PRIVSET.SNMP policies: Manage SNMP settings for sending alerts and traps from managed devices.
scopes.PRIVSET.SSH policies: Manage access control and settings for Secure Shell (SSH) connections, allowing secure remote management.
scopes.PRIVSET.SSL Certificates:
As a user with access to SSL Certificates, you can view and manage the SSL certificates used for secure communications within the system.
Note: This is a virtual appliance only privilege.
scopes.PRIVSET.Save and clone explorations: Save or clone an existing exploration.
scopes.PRIVSET.Scrub policies: As a Scrub Policy user, you can create, edit, delete, and manage virtual media policies, allowing you to configure and control remote media access for servers.
scopes.PRIVSET.Security and privacy: Configure data collection and connection to Intersight.
scopes.PRIVSET.Serial Over LAN policies: Manage remote access to the management console through the server's management interface, facilitating troubleshooting and server management without a direct connection.
scopes.PRIVSET.Server Administrator:
As a Server Administrator, you can view and manage UCS Servers and Fabric Interconnects,
view all the server and Fabric Interconnect dashboard widgets, perform server actions,
view server details, launch management interfaces and the CLI, create and deploy server
policies and profiles, and manage API keys. This role does not include the ability to claim a device.
You must have a Device Technician, Device Administrator, or an Account Administrator role to claim a device.
scopes.PRIVSET.Server Profiles:
A set of privileges that allows to manage server policies and server profiles.
Server Policy Management privilege set is the top level privilege set of other privilege set(s) which are mapped to privileges
related to server policy management.
scopes.PRIVSET.Server delete virtual drives: Remove virtual drives, managing storage volumes.
scopes.PRIVSET.Server enable and disable vHBAs: Enable or disable vHBAs to control storage operations.
scopes.PRIVSET.Server enable and disable vNICs: Enable or disable vNICs to manage network participation.
scopes.PRIVSET.Server hard reset: Initiate a hard reset on servers, restarting hardware without a graceful shutdown.
scopes.PRIVSET.Server power cycle: Perform a power cycle on servers, rebooting hardware.
scopes.PRIVSET.Server power off: Safely power off servers, terminating operations.
scopes.PRIVSET.Server power on: Initiate the power-on sequence for server activation.
scopes.PRIVSET.Server reset vHBAs: Reset vHBAs to resolve issues or refresh state.
scopes.PRIVSET.Server reset vNICs: Reset vNICs to resolve issues or refresh state.
scopes.PRIVSET.Server secure erase drives: Perform a secure erase on drives, permanently removing data.
scopes.PRIVSET.Server set drive states: Change drive states to control availability.
scopes.PRIVSET.Server shutdown OS: Initiate a graceful shutdown, ensuring services close properly before powering down.
scopes.PRIVSET.Servers:
A set of privileges that allows the access to detailed server information and to perform server related actions.
Servers privilege set is the top level privilege set of other privilege set(s) which are mapped to privileges
related to servers.
scopes.PRIVSET.Service Designer:
As a Service Designer, you can create tasks, workflows, custom datatypes, resource selection criteria, and use
these building blocks to create service items. The service items are used to create resources with attributes
in Intersight and associate with deploy, maintenance, and decommission actions on the resource.
scopes.PRIVSET.Service Operator:
As a Service Operator, you can view and update the catalog items, service items, and workflows.
You can deploy these resources and validate the catalog or service items.
scopes.PRIVSET.Set Fabric Interconnect user lab: Assign and manage user labels for Fabric Interconnect.
scopes.PRIVSET.Set IMC certificates: Assign and manage integrated management controller (IMC) certificates on servers.
scopes.PRIVSET.Set KMIP client certificates: Assign and manage key management interoperability protocol (KMIP) in Intersight for cryptographic keys and client certificates on servers.
scopes.PRIVSET.Set and unset IP pool tags: Assign or unassign tags to IP address pools for categorization.
scopes.PRIVSET.Set and unset chassis profile ta: As a Set or Unset chassis profile Tag user, you can apply tags to chassis profiles to categorize and manage them more effectively within your infrastructure.
scopes.PRIVSET.Set and unset domain profile tag: As a Set or Unset Domain Profile Tag user, you can assign, update or remove tags on a chassis profile.
scopes.PRIVSET.Set and unset server profile tag:
As a Set Server or Unset Profile Tag user, you can assign, remove and manage tags for server profiles.
This includes creating, updating, and ensuring tags are correctly applied for improved categorization and identification.
scopes.PRIVSET.Set chassis profile user labels: Assign and manage user labels for chassis profiles.
scopes.PRIVSET.Set chassis user labels: Assign and manage user labels for chassis.
scopes.PRIVSET.Set domain profile user labels: Assign and manage user labels for domain profiles.
scopes.PRIVSET.Set or Unset Fabric Interconnect: As a Set or Unset Fabric Interconnect Tag user, you can assign, update or remove tags.
scopes.PRIVSET.Set or Unset IQN Pool Tags: As a Set or Unset IQN Pool Tags user, you can assign tags to IQN pools or you can remove tags from IQN pools.
scopes.PRIVSET.Set or Unset MAC Pool Tags: As a Set or Unset MAC Pool Tags user, you can assign tags to MAC address pools or you can remove tags from MAC address pools.
scopes.PRIVSET.Set or Unset Resource Pool Tags: As a Set or Unset Resource Pool Tags user, you can assign tags to resource pools or you can remove tags from resource pools.
scopes.PRIVSET.Set or Unset Server Tag: As a Set or unset Server Tag user, you can assign, remove and manage tags for servers.
scopes.PRIVSET.Set or Unset UUID Pool Tags: As a Set or Unset UUID Pool Tags user, you can assign tags to UUID pools or you can remove tags from UUID pools.
scopes.PRIVSET.Set or Unset chassis Tag: As a Set or Unset chassis Tag user, you can assign update or remove tags on a chassis for better identification and management.
scopes.PRIVSET.Set or unset WWNN or WWPN pool t: Set or remove unique IDs for Fibre Channel resources on a server.
scopes.PRIVSET.Set server asset tags: Assign and manage asset tags for servers.
scopes.PRIVSET.Set server license tiers: Assign and manage Intersight license tiers for servers.
scopes.PRIVSET.Set server profile user labels: Assign and manage user labels for server profiles.
scopes.PRIVSET.Set server user labels: Assign and manage user labels for servers.
scopes.PRIVSET.Single sign-on: Manage single sign-on (SSO) integrations and authentication methods for seamless access to multiple applications.
scopes.PRIVSET.Soft stop VMs: Perform a soft stop on a virtual machine (VM).
scopes.PRIVSET.Start and resume VMs: Start or resume a virtual machine (VM).
scopes.PRIVSET.Storage Administrator:
As a Storage Administrator, a user can view and manage Storage devices, view and execute
workflows and view all the storage dashboard widgets.

This privilege does not include the ability to claim a device. You must have a
Device Technician, Device Administrator, or an Account Administrator role to claim a device.
scopes.PRIVSET.Storage Arrays:
A set of privileges that allows the access to detailed storage array information and to perform storage array related actions.
Storage Arrays privilege set is the top level privilege set of other privilege set(s) which are mapped to privileges
related to storage arrays.
scopes.PRIVSET.Storage policies: Manage storage resources (such as local drives, RAID configurations, and external storage).
scopes.PRIVSET.Support: Download server event logs, rediscover servers and chassis, control server and chassis locator LEDs, and start server alarm suppression in Intersight Infrastructure Services.
scopes.PRIVSET.Support Services: As a Support Services user, you can view the dashboard and table views of managed devices, change your user preferences, collect tech support bundles, and generate API keys. In this role, you cannot claim targets, add or remove users, configure Identity Providers, or perform server actions.
scopes.PRIVSET.Support chassis: Perform chassis support functions such as diagnostics, troubleshooting, and managing chassis health.
scopes.PRIVSET.Support domains: Perform domain support functions such as diagnostics, troubleshooting, and managing domain health.
scopes.PRIVSET.Support servers: Perform server support functions such as diagnostics, troubleshooting, and managing server health.
scopes.PRIVSET.Sustainability Metrics Viewer:
As a Sustainability Metrics Viewer user, you have read access to the Energy Management Capability (EMC) features and the ability
register an OAuth2 application for programmatic access to the APIs.
scopes.PRIVSET.Switch Control policies: Configure changes on the Fabric Interconnects for transitioning between in-host and switching modes, enabling VLAN Port optimization and managing system VLAN settings.
scopes.PRIVSET.Switch Profiles: A set of privileges that allows to manage Switch Profiles and Network configuration policies.
scopes.PRIVSET.Switch to Self Signed CSR:
As a user with the ability to switch to self-signed Certificate Signing Requests (CSR), you can change the configuration to use self-signed certificates for secure communications.
Note: This is a virtual appliance only privilege.
scopes.PRIVSET.Sync Smart Licensing: Manage and track Cisco licenses directly from the Intersight platform to ensure seamless monitoring of compliance and usage.
scopes.PRIVSET.Syslog policies: Manage local and remote logging  capabilities.
scopes.PRIVSET.System Administration: System related settings of Intersight Infrastructure Services. (Selecting any privilege under this hierarchy will change the scope of privilege set to 'All' and can not be used for 'Organization' scope in Role creation.)
scopes.PRIVSET.System QoS policies: Configure network traffic prioritization by assigning system classes for individual vNICs.
scopes.PRIVSET.Tag Management: Users can view and manage tag definitions. This role provides tag management privileges to an user.
scopes.PRIVSET.Tech support bundles: Manage and configure tech support bundles.
scopes.PRIVSET.Telemetry:
A set of privileges that allows to access to telemetry data.
Telemetry privilege set is the top level privilege set of other
privilege set(s) which are mapped to privileges related to Telemetry.
View Telemetry allows [POST of a Druid query](http://druid.io/docs/latest/querying/querying).
Manage Telemetry allows [READ of broker information](http://druid.io/docs/latest/operations/api-reference.html#broker).
scopes.PRIVSET.Terminate sessions: Terminate active vKVM, Tunneled vKVM, and VMRC console sessions launched from Intersight.
scopes.PRIVSET.Traffic mirroring SPAN session: As a Manage Traffic Mirroring Sessions user, you can set up and control traffic mirroring sessions to capture and analyze network traffic for monitoring, troubleshooting, or performance analysis.
scopes.PRIVSET.Trusted certificates: Manage trusted certificates for secure communications.
scopes.PRIVSET.Turn Fabric Extender locator LED: Turn on or off the LED locator on the selected FEX.
scopes.PRIVSET.Turn chassis locator LEDs on and: Toggle the locator LED on or off for the chassis to visually locate it within a rack or data center for maintenance.
scopes.PRIVSET.Turn server locator LEDs on and: Toggle the locator LED on or off to visually locate the server within a rack or data center for maintenance.
scopes.PRIVSET.UCS Domain Administrator: As a UCS Domain Administrator, you can view and manage Switch Profiles and Network Configuration Policies, view Fabric Interconnect dashboard widgets, perform actions on Switch, launch management interfaces and the CLI, create and deploy switch policies and profiles, and manage API keys. This role does not include the ability to claim a device. You must have a Device Technician, Device Administrator, or an Account Administrator role to claim a device.
scopes.PRIVSET.Unassign chassis profiles: Remove domain profiles from servers, disconnecting settings.
scopes.PRIVSET.Unassign domain profiles: Remove domain profiles, disconnecting server settings.
scopes.PRIVSET.Unassign server profiles: Unassign the server from the profile.
scopes.PRIVSET.Unclaim device connector:
Remove the association of a device connector from its current claim to allow reconfiguration or reassignment to a different system or user.
Note: This is a virtual appliance only privilege.
scopes.PRIVSET.Unclaim targets: Remove a target from the system's management or monitoring scope.
scopes.PRIVSET.Unified Edge: A set of privileges that allows to perform operations related to Unified Edge chassis.
scopes.PRIVSET.Unified Edge Administrator: As a Unified Edge Administrator, you can view and manage Switch Profiles and Network Configuration Policies, view Unified Edge dashboard widgets, perform actions on Switch, launch management interfaces and the CLI, create and deploy switch policies and profiles, and manage API keys. This role does not include the ability to claim a device. You must have a Device Technician, Device Administrator, or an Account Administrator role to claim a device.
scopes.PRIVSET.Unified Edge Profiles: A set of privileges that allows to manage Unified Edge Profiles, Network and Chassis configuration policies.
scopes.PRIVSET.Unlock and lock front panels: Control access to the server's front panel.
scopes.PRIVSET.Unlock disks: Unlock encrypted disks to grant data access.
scopes.PRIVSET.Update reserved licenses:
Reserve licenses again and generate a new authorization code in Smart Licensing Manager.
Note: This is a virtual appliance only privilege.
scopes.PRIVSET.Upgrade chassis firmware: Update the firmware of a chassis.
scopes.PRIVSET.Upgrade domain firmware: Update the firmware for a Domain.
scopes.PRIVSET.Upgrade server firmware: Disconnect the server from the network, erase all data, and update inventory records to reflect the change.
scopes.PRIVSET.User Access Administrator:
As a User Access Administrator, you can add and manage Users and Groups in Intersight, view account details
and audit logs, manage the IdPs, roles, sessions and API keys for non Account Administrator users.
However, you cannot claim a device or perform any management tasks in Intersight.
You cannot add or manage a user with Account Administrator role.
scopes.PRIVSET.VLAN policies: Set up network segmentation by defining VLANs specific to organizations.
scopes.PRIVSET.VSAN policies: Configure Virtual Storage Area Networks (VSANs) on fabric fibre channel uplinks.
scopes.PRIVSET.Verify domain names: Perform checks and validations on domain names to ensure correctness and functionality for network addressing and resource identification.
scopes.PRIVSET.View Access and Permissions: View access control rules and permissions.
scopes.PRIVSET.View Devices: A set of privileges that allows read access to devices.
scopes.PRIVSET.View Exports: A set of privileges that allow users to view export operations.
scopes.PRIVSET.View Functions: A set of privileges that allows the users to view serverless functions.
scopes.PRIVSET.View Hypervisors: A set of privileges that allow users to view hypervisor and virtual machines related inventory and dashboards.
scopes.PRIVSET.View Imports: A set of privileges that allow users to view the import operations.
scopes.PRIVSET.View Language Runtimes: A set of privileges that allows the users to view language runtimes for serverless functions.
scopes.PRIVSET.View Network Switches: A set of privileges that allow the users to view the network switches.
scopes.PRIVSET.View Nexus Config: A set of privileges that allows users to view their site templates and policies.
scopes.PRIVSET.View Nexus Reports: A set of privileges that allow the users to view nexus reports.
scopes.PRIVSET.View Nexus Sites: A set of privileges that allows users to view their onboarded sites and status.
scopes.PRIVSET.View SAN Switches: A set of privileges that allow the users to view the SAN switches.
scopes.PRIVSET.View Storage Arrays: A set of privileges that allow the users to view storage related inventory and dashboards.
scopes.PRIVSET.View Workflow Definitions: A set of privileges that allow the users to view the workflow, task and custom data type definitions.
scopes.PRIVSET.View Workflow Executions: A set of privileges that allow the users to view the running instances of the workflows.
scopes.PRIVSET.View Workload Definitions: A set of privileges that allow the users to view workload definitions.
scopes.PRIVSET.View Workload Deployments: A set of privileges that allow the users to view workload deployments.
scopes.PRIVSET.View sessions: View and terminate active vKVM, Tunneled vKVM, and VMRC console sessions launched from Intersight, and view session history.
scopes.PRIVSET.View virtual machine templates: Manage and configure virtual machine (VM) templates.
scopes.PRIVSET.Virtual Media policies: Enable the virtual media service on the endpoint, encryption of all communications and low power USB.
scopes.PRIVSET.Virtual appliance licensing:
Manage the licensing for virtual appliance (VA). Learn more, Introduction to Licensing.
Note: This is a virtual appliance only privilege.
scopes.PRIVSET.Virtualization Administrator:
As a Virtualization Administrator, a user can view and manage hypervisor resources, view
and execute workflows.

This privilege does not include the ability to claim a device. You must have a
Device Technician, Device Administrator, or an Account Administrator role to claim a device.
scopes.PRIVSET.Workflow Designer:
As a Workflow Designer, you can define workflow definitions and custom data types,
view workflow definitions, task definitions and custom data types, execute workflows and
view workflow executions.
scopes.PRIVSET.Workload Administrator:
As a Workload Administrator, you can define workload definitions using Blueprints and underlying ServiceItems 
and workflow definitions. You can also define workload deployments using Workload Definitions and deploy workloads 
to target devices.
scopes.PRIVSET.Workload Designer:
As a Workload Designer, you can define workload definitions using Blueprints and underlying ServiceItems 
and workflow definitions.
scopes.PRIVSET.Workload Operator:
As a Workload Operator, you can define workload deployments using Workload Definitions and deploy workloads 
to target devices.
scopes.PRIVSET.Workload Optimizer Administrator:
As a Workload Optimizer Administrator, you can access all Workload Optimizer features and perform 
administrative tasks to configure Workload Optimizer.
scopes.PRIVSET.Workload Optimizer Advisor:
As a Workload Optimizer Advisor, you can view workload optimization state and recommended actions,
run plans for workload optimization.
scopes.PRIVSET.Workload Optimizer Automator:
As a Workload Optimizer Automator, you can view workload optimization state, recommended actions,
run plans for workload optimization, execute workload optimization actions, and deploy workloads.
scopes.PRIVSET.Workload Optimizer Deployer:
As a Workload Optimizer Deployer, you can view all Workload Optimizer charts and data, deploy 
workloads, and create policies and templates. You cannot run plans or execute any recommended actions.
scopes.PRIVSET.Workload Optimizer Observer: As a Workload Optimizer Observer, you can view workload optimization state and recommended actions.
scopes.PRIVSET.iSCSI Adapter policies: Configure settings for iSCSI traffic management, including TCP Connection Timeout, DHCP Timeout, and Retry Count for busy LUN IDs, optimizing iSCSI boot configurations.
scopes.PRIVSET.iSCSI Boot policies: Configure settings required to enable a server to boot from an iSCSI-based storage device.
scopes.PRIVSET.iSCSI Static Target policies: Define static iSCSI target configuration settings for servers that need to connect to specific storage devices over the iSCSI protocol.
scopes.PRIVSET.vKVM Only: As a vKVM-only user, you can launch vKVM and tunneled vKVM sessions to a server from Intersight. In addition you can view servers, chassis and the running workflows. In this role, you cannot perform any server actions from Intersight apart from launching vKVM.
scopes.UPDATE.asset.DeviceRegistration: Updates the resource representing the device connector. For example, this can be used to annotate the device connector resource with user-specified tags.
